entities.summary: John Francis Robert "Jake" Pelkington Jr. was an American professional basketball player in the American Basketball League (ABL), National Basketball League (NBL), and Basketball Association of America (BAA). Pelkington enjoyed success in his career, winning three league championships and was a three-time second-team all-NBL selection. He is 10th all-time in NBL career scoring with 1,949 points.
